edits.js: const w = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let n, k = 0; while ((n = w.nextNode())) { if (!/\d/.test(n.textContent) || !n.parentElement || !n.parentElement.offsetParent) continue; if (k++ % 2) continue; n.textContent = n.textContent.replace(/(\d+)([.,]\d+)?/, (m, a, b) => "round" === 'round' && b ? a : String(+a + 1) + (b || '')); }
